key_insight: Retaining one fluid relaxation mode is essential to predict nonlinear response, stability, and dynamic pull-in in electrostatic microbeams with squeeze-film damping.
engineering_relevance: A reduced model with three real unknowns makes coupled fluid–structure safety analyses affordable for electrostatic microbeam design.
method: Build a reduced-order model from coupled fluid–structure complex modes and fluid relaxation modes.
Continue periodic responses in frequency and assess stability using Floquet multipliers.
Map basins of attraction, integrity measures, and dynamic pull-in across excitation parameters.
evidence_signal: The model was validated against measured and computed microswitch frequency responses; across all simulated devices, one fluid mode was necessary and sufficient.
watch_item: The single-fluid-mode result applies to the simulated devices; new geometries and operating regimes require validation.
paper_title: Why fluid relaxation modes matter: Nonlinear frequency response, dynamical integrity, and dynamic pull-in of electrostatic microbeams with squeeze-film damping
